projection.currentAuthority: Every load rechecks current map access, selected Profile sheet authority, current Trainer roster links, and the explicit shared-group policy before projection.
projection.public: Public loads expose public reward amounts, public gate kinds and resolutions, cleanup categories, aggregate counts, completion, and allowlisted public history only.
projection.owner: Owner loads add only current participant, destination, and history subjects authorized by exact Profile-linked sheet or player-facing shared-group authority.
projection.gm: GM loads may include private narrative summaries and exact consequence fields and snapshots, but still omit internal orchestration identities.
projection.staleDraft: An expected-revision mismatch returns the current safe projection with freshness stale-draft and never rebases or submits the old draft.
projection.groupCustody: Only the player-facing main group inventory grants player destination-owner authority; another existing group row remains GM custody.

forbiddenByDefault: settlement, reward, allocation, receipt, decision, and fact identities
source row and serialized equipment identities
private notes outside their explicit audience
stored commands, plans, evidence, and provenance
privacy.historyAllowlist: Each history kind is rebuilt from a closed detail allowlist; stored payload objects are never returned directly.
privacy.privateRewards: GM-only reward lines and narrative notes are absent from public and unauthorized owner JSON, history, and realtime payloads.
privacy.correctionSummary: A visible correction exposes only closed reason code, successor settlement revision, and correction campaign minute.

realtime.transactionalJournal: Settlement and correction events are appended in the same SQLite transaction as accepted state and evidence.
realtime.postCommitPublication: Publication runs after commit; a publisher failure is reported while durable replay remains authoritative.
realtime.deliveryRule: Current resource access and settlement projection audience are both checked on live SSE delivery and replay.
realtime.gmConvergence: GM delivery excludes public and owner variants so a later redacted event cannot replace the GM projection.
realtime.ownerConvergence: Owner events signal the accepted revision; the current role-safe load is canonical when one Profile aggregates several sheet authorities.

correction.authorization: Only a GM may accept a correction offer built from one complete current owning-mechanics authority snapshot.
correction.eligibleSource: One existing accepted non-completion, non-cancelled receipt may be superseded once.
correction.appendOnly: Correction adds one accepted decision, linked correction receipt, settlement revision, and private operation row; original receipts and history remain unchanged.
correction.offerBinding: The hash-bound offer includes source receipt, reason, settlement revision, owning authority reference and definition hash, campaign minute, GM principal, and exact successor document.
correction.lockedRevalidation: Under the SQLite write lock, settlement, offer, authority, and campaign minute must still match before one revision is written.
correction.exactReplay: The same strict command and principal replays the durable result across restart without reauthorization, another write, or another publication.

recovery.load: Current load restores role-safe settlement, bounded history, visible corrections, and stale-draft status after reconnect or restart.
recovery.operationStatus: GM-only status accepts exactly one retained strict command and returns only accepted safe metadata or unknown with explicit-only retry.
recovery.noAutomaticReplay: Reconnect never submits a retained commit or correction command. Unknown status requires a fresh explicit user action.
recovery.identityConflict: Changed principals, changed commands, malformed evidence, and operation identities present in both journals fail closed without revealing prior data.

immutableAudit.commit: Command, complete plan, authority hash, result, history, and attention rows remain bound to the exact accepted commit evidence.
immutableAudit.correction: Command, source receipt, closed reason, complete offer, authority hash, and result remain bound to the exact accepted correction evidence.
immutableAudit.readVerification: Repository reads recompute plan or offer hashes and compare history and attention payloads with accepted operation evidence.
immutableAudit.crossJournalUniqueness: Commit and correction repositories reject an operation identity already present in the other journal.
immutableAudit.storage: Schema 43 adds immutable authority-linked correction rows; schema 44 preserves them while widening only the bounded guided-item request kind.
